Ugh, okay, I'm in the same boat. Here are a few options depending on how formal you need to be and how much detail you want to give.

**Short & Sweet (Casual):**

* "Ah, can't make it this time, sorry!"
* "Thanks for the invite! I'm tied up that day though."
* "Bummer, I won't be able to swing it."

**Slightly More Polite (Friendly):**

* "Thanks so much for thinking of me! Unfortunately, I'm already booked up."
* "That sounds fun, but I can't make it work right now."
* "Thanks for the invite! Raincheck soon?" (If you actually want to suggest another time)

**A Bit More Formal (Professional/Distant):**

* "Thanks for the invitation. I won't be able to attend, unfortunately."
* "Appreciate you inviting me. I have something else going on that day."
* "Thanks for reaching out. Sadly, I'm unavailable then."

**The Vague but Kind Approach (Good middle ground):**

* "Thanks for the invite! I'm going to have to pass this time around."
* "Sounds great, but I can't commit to that one."

**Pro-Tip:** Pick the one that matches your relationship with the person inviting you. Keep it brief, and don't over-explain—that usually just makes it sound like you're making up an excuse. 👍
